### The Taste of Worship
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/taste-of-worship
Passage: Psalm 34:8
Points:
- Taste plays a vital role in worship, particularly when taking the Lord's Supper.
- Scripture uses taste imagery to develop holy affections and describe delight in God.
- God historically used taste, such as Passover's bitter herbs, to help His people remember salvation.
- Communion bread and wine remind believers that Christ satisfies our souls and turns sorrow into joy.
- Partaking of the elements prompts Christians to reflect on Christ’s spiritual nourishment and sacrifice.

### 6 Ways to Get Unstuck in Grief
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-august-5-2026.html
Passage: Psalm 34:18
Points:
- Experiencing loss is unavoidable, and attempting to suppress emotions keeps people stuck in grief.
- God does not stand far off; He draws nearest to believers when their hearts are crushed.
- Jesus understands human sorrow intimately and grieves alongside those who hurt.
- Healing is fostered within Christian community as believers mourn together and support one another.
- God uses sorrow to cultivate endurance, point toward eternal hope, and comfort others facing trials.

### Taste God's Goodness in Every Meal
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/taste-gods-goodness-in-every-meal-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 34:8
Points:
- The rich variety and flavor of food reveal God’s immense creativity and generosity.
- Enjoying everyday meals opens the door to wonder and helps people appreciate God's goodness.
- Expressing gratitude through mealtime prayer strengthens our recognition of God's love and provision.
- Exploring diverse cultural foods and recipes offers tangible ways to savor God's blessings.
- Physical nourishment points toward Jesus as the true bread of life who satisfies our deepest spiritual hunger.

### Try it... You'll Like it!
Author: Jim Burns
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-feb-4-2008-11566644.html
Passage: Psalm 34:8
Points:
- True belief is not mere intellectual agreement, but committing your entire life into God's hands.
- Following Christ requires stepping outside of comfort zones and taking risks in faith.
- Trusting the infinite Creator makes sense because He understands our lives far better than we do.
- Experiencing the Lord's goodness requires taking personal initiative to seek refuge in Him.
